answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using hardware-rooted remote attestation. Each agent proves uniqueness with a deterministic attestation signature bound to a Trusted Platform Module endorsement key, anchoring one identity thread per chip. Attackers incur the verifiable capital cost of buying separate physical silicon per fake account. However, manufacturer root certificates create a walled garden that excludes open hardware and bends like willow under physical key-extraction attacks.
